notes: Exact integer/field oracle, not encrypted latency. Fixed public T partitions, common worst-block padding, CRT virtual padding, index-only metric order. Map bytes include anchors and sparse nonpivot field relations. Stable ID arrays, encrypted setup, epoch binding, private arithmetic and authentication remain separate costs.
